signIn.description: Sign in to access your photography studio dashboard.
signIn.mfaDescription: Enter the 6-digit verification code from your authenticator app.
signIn.passkeyNotSupported: Passkeys are not supported on this device.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot Password
forgotPassword.description: Enter your email address to receive a secure password reset link.
forgotPassword.successMessage: If an account exists for this email address, a password reset link has been dispatched.

resetPassword.description: Enter your new password to regain access to your account.

verifyEmail.description: Verify your email address for secure communications.

verifyEmail.statusVerified: Your email address has been verified successfully.

security.title: Security & Multi-Factor Authentication
security.description: Manage your two-factor authentication, passkeys, recovery codes, and active sessions.
security.totpDescription: Use an authenticator application (such as Google Authenticator, 1Password, or Bitwarden) for multi-factor authentication.
security.totpSetupInstructions: Scan the QR code below with your authenticator application, or manually enter the secret key.
security.qrCodeAlt: QR Code for TOTP authenticator enrolment
security.recoveryCodesDescription: Save these 10 recovery codes in a safe place. Each code can only be used once if you lose access to your authenticator device.
security.recoveryCodesWarning: These codes are displayed once and cannot be viewed again. Please copy or download them now.
security.confirmRecoveryCodes: I have safely stored these codes
security.passkeysDescription: Sign in passwordlessly and securely using biometrics (Touch ID, Face ID, Windows Hello) or hardware security keys.
security.sessionsDescription: Manage and revoke active sessions logged in to your studio.
security.reauthDescription: For your security, please confirm your master password before performing this sensitive operation.
security.mfaEnforcedAlert: Multi-factor authentication is required by studio policy. Please configure an authenticator app or passkey before accessing other studio features.
security.mfaPostponeNotice: Multi-factor authentication will become mandatory on {date}.

errors.INVALID_RECOVERY_CODE: Invalid recovery code. Each recovery code can only be used once.

errors.REAUTH_REQUIRED: Re-authentication required. Please enter your password to proceed.

dangerZone.description: Destructive actions that permanently remove data.
dangerZone.deleteClientDescription: Permanently erase this client, all contacts, addresses, notes, tags, timeline, and consent records.

retentionIndicator.title: Data retention
retentionIndicator.scheduledAutomaticErasure: Scheduled for automatic erasure on {date} without further activity.
retentionIndicator.pausedByHold: Automatic erasure is paused by an active legal hold.
retentionIndicator.pendingErasure: Pending automatic erasure on next sweep.
retentionIndicator.policyInfo: Clients inactive for 36 months are erased automatically.

legalHold.title: Legal hold
legalHold.description: Temporarily or indefinitely suspend automatic and manual erasure for this client.
legalHold.dialogDescription: Specify the reason and optional duration for holding client data from erasure.
legalHold.noteHint: Do not record special-category personal data (such as health or biometric details).
legalHold.notePlaceholder: Describe the legal context or reference...
legalHold.untilHint: Leave empty for an indefinite hold.
legalHold.releaseConfirmDescription: Releasing the legal hold will re-enable automatic retention sweeps and allow manual erasure of this client.
legalHold.errorGeneric: An error occurred while updating legal hold.
legalHold.errorPastDate: Expiration date must be today or later.

export.title: Export personal data
export.description: Generate a machine-readable JSON or printable HTML data subject access export (DSAR, Art. 15 GDPR) for {name}.
export.reviewNotice: Before delivering this export to the data subject, carefully review the contents for third-party personal data (such as names or details of partners, guests, or associates mentioned in notes or timeline events) that must be redacted.
export.reauthDescription: Data export requires confirmation with your account password (recent within 5 minutes).
export.errorGeneric: Export generation failed. Please try again.

erasure.descriptionClient: Review the data that will be permanently erased for this client.
erasure.descriptionContact: Review the data that will be permanently erased for {name}.
erasure.holdsTitle: Erasure blocked by active retention hold
erasure.holdsDescription: This subject cannot be deleted because statutory or legal retention requirements forbid erasure:
erasure.warningNotesMayMention: Other free-text notes for this client may mention this person. Please review client notes manually after erasure.
erasure.reauthDescription: Destructive erasure requires confirming your account password (recent within 5 minutes).
erasure.successClient: Client and all associated records have been erased.
erasure.successContact: Person and associated records have been erased.
erasure.errorConfirmationMismatch: The entered confirmation text does not match the client name.
erasure.errorBlocked: Erasure was blocked because active retention holds exist.
